result.instructions: Tools for Linkly, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which of our short links got the most clicks in the last 30 days?"; "Show me the top referrers for the spring campaign links."; "Create a short link for https://example.com/offer with utm_campaign spring.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Linkly data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run linkly_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run linkly_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run linkly_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. linkly_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: linkly_list_workspaces
tools.title: List workspaces
tools.description: List the Linkly workspaces this API key can access, with their ids. Call this first to find the workspace_id for the other tools. Linkly API: GET /api/v1/workspaces.

tools.name: linkly_list_links
tools.title: List links
tools.description: List the short links in a workspace, with click totals (today, 30 days, all time), domain and destination. Supports search, sorting and pages. Linkly API: GET /api/v1/workspace/{workspace_id}/list_links.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id. Use linkly_list_workspaces to find it.

page_size.description: Links per page (default set by Linkly).

sort_by.description: Field to sort by, as Linkly names it (for example clicks_total).

deleted.description: List deleted links (true) or live links (false, default).

tools.name: linkly_get_link
tools.title: Get link
tools.description: Get one short link: destination, short URL, UTM parameters, rules and settings. Click counts are not included; use linkly_get_clicks or linkly_list_links for them. Linkly API: GET /api/v1/link/{id}.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id. Use linkly_list_workspaces to find it.

tools.name: linkly_get_clicks
tools.title: Get clicks
tools.description: Get a click time series for a workspace or for chosen links, with filters for country, browser, platform, referer, bots and unique visitors. Analytics calls draw on the workspace's plan allowance. Linkly API: GET /api/v1/workspace/{workspace_id}/clicks.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id. Use linkly_list_workspaces to find it.

link_id.description: One link id to filter by.

link_ids.description: Comma-separated link ids to filter by.

start.description: Start of the period, as the API accepts it (ISO 8601 date or datetime).

end.description: End of the period, as the API accepts it (ISO 8601 date or datetime).

country.description: Filter by country (as the API names it).

bots.description: Include (true) or exclude (false) known bot traffic.

unique.description: Count unique visitors only (true) or all clicks (false).

timezone.description: IANA timezone for the series (for example Europe/Prague).

frequency.description: Bucket size of the series (default day).

tools.name: linkly_get_click_counters
tools.title: Get click counters
tools.description: Get the top values of one click dimension (for example country, city, referer, utm_source, destination) with click counts. Linkly API: GET /api/v1/workspace/{workspace_id}/clicks/counters/{counter}.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id. Use linkly_list_workspaces to find it.

link_id.description: One link id to filter by.

link_ids.description: Comma-separated link ids to filter by.

start.description: Start of the period, as the API accepts it (ISO 8601 date or datetime).

end.description: End of the period, as the API accepts it (ISO 8601 date or datetime).

country.description: Filter by country (as the API names it).

bots.description: Include (true) or exclude (false) known bot traffic.

unique.description: Count unique visitors only (true) or all clicks (false).

tools.name: linkly_list_conversions
tools.title: List conversions
tools.description: List recorded conversions (goal events tied to clicks) for a workspace, newest first, with a page cursor. Linkly API: GET /api/v1/conversions.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id. Use linkly_list_workspaces to find it.

limit.description: Maximum number of conversions to return.

tools.name: linkly_list_domains
tools.title: List domains
tools.description: List the custom short-link domains of a workspace, with their ids and verification state. Linkly API: GET /api/v1/workspace/{workspace_id}/domains.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id. Use linkly_list_workspaces to find it.

tools.name: linkly_list_workspace_webhooks
tools.title: List workspace webhooks
tools.description: List the click-notification webhooks subscribed to a workspace. Linkly API: GET /api/v1/workspace/{workspace_id}/webhooks.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id. Use linkly_list_workspaces to find it.

tools.name: linkly_list_link_webhooks
tools.title: List link webhooks
tools.description: List the click-notification webhooks subscribed to one short link. Linkly API: GET /api/v1/link/{link_id}/webhooks.

tools.name: linkly_create_or_update_link
tools.title: Create or update link
tools.description: Create a short link in a workspace (give url and workspace_id), or update an existing link (give its id and only the fields to change). An update changes where a live short link sends visitors. Linkly API: POST /api/v1/link.

id.description: Existing link id to update. Leave empty to create a new link.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id. Required when creating a link.

url.description: Destination URL (required when creating a link).

slug.description: Custom slug for the short link (random when empty).

domain.description: Custom short-link domain, as configured in the workspace.

name.description: Internal name for the link (not shown to visitors).

enabled.description: Turn the link on (true) or off (false).

utm_source.description: UTM source appended to the destination.

utm_medium.description: UTM medium appended to the destination.

utm_campaign.description: UTM campaign appended to the destination.

utm_term.description: UTM term appended to the destination.

utm_content.description: UTM content appended to the destination.
